text.moon: Lt. Haddad wants a full check of the antennas with the tracking stations. It takes a few hours.
text.mars: Lt. Haddad wants a full check of the antennas. Signals to Mars will be faint, so every dish counts.

nodes.fact: NASA's Deep Space Network has huge dishes in California, Spain and Australia, so one is always facing space as Earth spins.
